name: home-bound-veteran-third
expression: async()=>{window.__earthGpuRoute=async(x,z)=>{const move=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!move.ok)throw Error(move.error);const start=performance.now();await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const f=()=>{const d=Realm.diagnostics,p=d.adventure.player;if(d.adventure.paused||Realm.state.adventure.hp<=0)return reject(Error('Route paused or traveler died'));if(Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)<.15&&!Realm.test.path.length)return resolve();if(performance.now()-start>90000)return reject(Error('Real RAF route timed out'));requestAnimationFrame(f);};requestAnimationFrame(f);});return{destination:{x,z},body:Realm.diagnostics.adventure.player,method:'Production moveTo and ordinary RAF; no coordinate write or accelerated tick'};};Realm.test.pause(false);Realm.test.worldContext();Realm.test.view({yaw:.4,elevation:.22,distance:9,half:14});return{source:'Command-earned returning strongest-gear finite binding checkpoint; application restore for measured scene setup',diagnostics:Realm.diagnostics};}

name: root-pocket-live-encounter-third
expression: async()=>{document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="adventure"]').click();await __earthGpuRoute(-148,-66);const e=Realm.state.earthExpedition,p=e.patrol.active;if(!p||p.run!==3)throw Error('Expected unpaid earned run3');const r=Realm.test.expeditionCommand('patrol-step',{quest:RealmEarthExpedition.patrol.id,run:p.run,priorClaim:e.patrol.lastClaim,step:'inspect-root'});if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);await __earthGpuRoute(-134,-68.9);Realm.test.view({yaw:.4,elevation:.25,distance:8});return{acceptedStep:r,actors:Realm.diagnostics.adventure.enemyCount,hp:Realm.state.adventure.hp,method:'Actual accepted patrol root encounter; ordinary RAF and no health/position grant; automatic attacks left off'};}

name: root-pocket-live-encounter-diorama
expression: ()=>{document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="follow"]').click();Realm.test.view({yaw:.4,elevation:.67,half:14});return{hp:Realm.state.adventure.hp,method:'Same real encounter continues without health scaling or simulation acceleration'};}
